display.purpose: Patient home greeting; at most once per screen.

display-sm.purpose: The patient's name on Home; one large personal line.

body.purpose: All patient reading text and chat messages. Never below 16px for patients.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Default for glass cards and the tab bar.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Small solid items sitting on glass.

shadows.name: cta
shadows.purpose: Green glow under the single primary button only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:48px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; font:600 15px/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, box-shadow .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6b57; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#1f6b57; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgb(31 107 87 / 0.7); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#17503f; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral glass action: Cancel, Download, Save draft.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:48px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:9999px; font:600 15px/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#26332f; background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(150%); border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn2:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6b57; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Brand action that must not compete with primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { height:48px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; font:600 15px/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; background:#dcebe2; color:#1f6b57; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background:#cfe3d6; } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6b57; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label + white field with a soft eucalyptus focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font:600 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#26332f; } .ds-input { height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #d3e3d9; border-radius:14px; background:#fff; font:400 16px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#26332f; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgb(79 95 88 / 0.7); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#1f6b57; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgb(31 107 87 / 0.1); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Single-choice quick pick; selected shows a check.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-chip { height:40px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid #d3e3d9; background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); color:#26332f; font:400 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-chip-on { background:#1f6b57; border-color:#1f6b57; color:#fff; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The default surface over the garden background.
components.html:
Dr. [NAME]

Your doctor usually replies within a day.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:20px; border-radius:28px; background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(150%); border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgb(31 74 60 / 0.4); font:400 16px/1.5 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#26332f; } .ds-card strong { font-size:17px; } .ds-card p { margin:4px 0 0; color:#4f5f58; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status pill: always words, ideally an icon.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:9999px; background:#dcebe2; color:#1f6b57; font:600 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-pending { background:transparent; border:1px dashed #8faf9b; color:#4f5f58; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Floating glass pill navigation, icon over label.
components.html: HomeChatPrescriptionsProfile
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:4px; height:70px; padding:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(24px); border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgb(31 74 60 / 0.4); } .ds-tab { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; font:500 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#4f5f58; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color:#26332f; } .ds-tab-on { background:#dcebe2; color:#1f6b57; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview: CareConnect should feel like a waiting room you'd actually want to sit in. The screen rests on a pale mint ground, washed with soft sage and ivory light and a faint pattern of line-drawn leaves. Content sits on panes of frosted glass, so the garden shows through without competing. Nothing is loud. One deep eucalyptus green does the work of saying "this is the thing to tap", and everything else stays quiet. The patient side is spacious and obvious; the doctor side reuses the same materials more densely. Both are the same garden, seen from a different chair.
keyCharacteristics: A single warm-green accent against soft mint neutrals.
Frosted-glass surfaces over a fixed, softly lit background.
Generous radii: pills for actions, 28px for cards.
Long, soft, green-tinted shadows rather than grey ones.
Inter throughout, with tight tracking on headings and plain sentence-case copy.

rules.name: The One Green Voice Rule
rules.body: Eucalyptus is the only saturated colour on a screen, and only one filled-eucalyptus button appears per screen.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token in src/app/globals.css. A hex value in a component is a bug.

rules.name: The Words-With-Colour Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone. Every badge carries text, and ideally an icon.

rules.name: The 16px Patient Floor Rule
rules.body: Patient reading text is never below 16px.

rules.name: The Indic Headroom Rule
rules.body: Never fix line heights or clip text in a way that would cut off Kannada or Hindi.

rules.name: The Three Panes Rule
rules.body: Use the glass utilities or Card, never a hand-written backdrop-filter.

rules.name: The Scale-Only Rule
rules.body: These eight sizes are the whole scale (plus 11px for the unread counter only). A new size gets added on purpose, or it does not ship.

dos: Do use exactly one variant="primary" button per screen.
Do keep patient text at 16px or more and patient targets at 44px or more, and pair every icon with a text label.
Do build surfaces from Card or the glass, glass-subtle and glass-strong utilities.
Do use green-tinted shadows from the token set.
Do write status as badge text plus an icon.
donts: Don't write hex colours or backdrop-filter in components.
Don't make it look like hospital software: cold blue and white, dense clinical tables for patients, jargon.
Don't make it look like generic SaaS: purple or rainbow gradients, dashboard-card grids, marketing hero styling.
Don't copy WhatsApp's green-and-beige chat look.
Don't add background blobs or patterns inside pages. BackgroundScene owns that.
Don't introduce a second typeface or colour accent.
